subject: Deep Neural Network
source_sentence: For this task, we have collected humming data and transcribed them in order to train a Deep Neural Network (DNN) based Hid- den Markov Model (HMM) for note transcription.
title: A Machine Learning based Music Retrieval and Recommendation System

subject: Features
source_sentence: The extracted features are then used to train the models by using the greedy layer-wise supervised training method, which takes the extracted features as input and uses three hidden layers for training, which was found to be the optimal number of layers for this task.
title: A Machine Learning based Music Retrieval and Recommendation System

subject: retrieval
source_sentence: The retrieval method is used to generate a ranked list of top 20 songs most similar to the query.
title: A Machine Learning based Music Retrieval and Recommendation System

subject: Logistic Regression
source_sentence: We use logistic regression to train the model and update the weights with the stochastic gradient descent.
title: A Machine Learning based Music Retrieval and Recommendation System

subject: Deep Neural Network
source_sentence: We propose a Deep Neural Network (DNN) based note transcription method and create a complete query by humming music retrieval system, which we test using the standard MIREX Query by humming data set.
title: A Machine Learning based Music Retrieval and Recommendation System

subject: plan
source_sentence: We plan to collect more data in the future and test the system on a larger dataset.
title: A Machine Learning based Music Retrieval and Recommendation System
